title: CudaEnvironmentValidationContract
description: CUDA GPU environment inspection and verification interface contract for src/utils/cuda_env.py and scripts/common.sh

cuda_available.description: True if NVIDIA GPU and CUDA driver runtime are active

gpu_count.description: Number of available NVIDIA GPUs (must be >= 1)

llama_supports_gpu.description: True if llama-cpp-python package binary supports CUDA GPU offloading
